decisions_taken: Push secret is NUGET_PREVIEW_KEY in the nuget-preview environment (not NUGET_KEY, so it can't fall back to the org secret).

Two dispatch jobs: publish-preview (pack/check, contents: read, no secrets, no environment) and publish-preview-push (environment nuget-preview, permissions {}, own concurrency group publish-preview with cancel-in-progress false, needs build+lint+publish-preview).
Every packable project = every csproj under src/ (decision 13; same rule as tests/Resultful.EndToEnd/Feed.cs); Resultful.slnx doesn't list every project.
preview input is a string with empty default, validated as a positive integer; dry-run boolean defaults true.
No --skip-duplicate on the preview push so a number is used once.
